conclusions.loveda_standard: Confirmed: raw 0 ignored; raw 1..7 mapped to 0..6 including background; apply once.
conclusions.loveda_historical: SAM3 release configs confirmed; RSKT historical numbers remain not fully bound to an actual preprocessing/evaluation run.
conclusions.uavid: Known 7-vs-8 taxonomy difference; remap predictions and GT then rescore, never convert a scalar mIoU.
conclusions.isaid: Known GT-background ignored vs scored difference; dropping background IoU from a mean does not reproduce ignore-GT-background evaluation.

rose_promptbank_check.conclusion: Current parser returns 26. README claims 25; previous claim that current release contains only 25 is superseded. Matching count does not validate paper-equivalent prompts, settings, or mIoU.
